description: Column definitions for OpenSpecLib Format v1 files. Normative. 'Monolithic' below means a collection from a single source, as opposed to an aggregated collection with contributing datasets. The `extension` field says where a column may appear: null = core column, required in every collection file; an extension name = allowed only when the footer declares that extension; "*" = allowed in any file without a declaration; "index" = index files only. `type` uses Apache Arrow type names; large and view variants of string and list are equivalent, and list child field names and child nullability are not significant (spec section 4). Index files contain every column except `wavelengths`, `values`, `bandpass_fwhm` and `values_stddev`, plus the index-only columns.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Globally unique spectrum identifier: `{collection}:{local_id}`. See rule F5 for the grammar.

columns.name: collection
columns.description: Collection identifier. MUST equal the footer `collection.id` on every row.

columns.name: original_id
columns.description: The identifier the upstream source uses, unchanged.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Human-readable display label. SHOULD distinguish the spectrum from others with the same material_name.

columns.name: material_name
columns.description: Name of the measured material, e.g. 'Olivine', 'Quercus alba', 'water'.

columns.name: material_category
columns.description: Top-level material class. Vocabulary: `material_category`.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Physical quantity of `values`. Vocabulary: `quantity`.

columns.name: geometry
columns.description: Illumination/viewing geometry of the measurement. Vocabulary: `geometry`. Use 'unknown' when the source does not state it.

columns.name: wavelength_unit
columns.description: Unit of `wavelengths`, kept native to the source. Vocabulary: `wavelength_unit`.

columns.name: wavelengths
columns.description: Spectral axis. Finite, strictly monotonic, at least 2 points.

columns.name: values
columns.description: Measured values, same length as `wavelengths`. NaN marks a missing or invalid band. No other sentinel values.

columns.name: wavelength_min_nm
columns.description: Shortest wavelength of the axis, in nanometres, whatever `wavelength_unit` is. Lets readers filter across collections without unit conversion.

columns.name: wavelength_max_nm
columns.description: Longest wavelength of the axis, in nanometres.

columns.name: license
columns.description: SPDX license expression for this spectrum (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0', 'ODbL-1.0'), a 'LicenseRef-' identifier defined in the footer, or 'NOASSERTION'.

columns.name: dataset_id
columns.description: For aggregated collections: key into the footer `datasets` map (matching `^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{1,200}$`). Null for monolithic collections; never an empty string.

columns.name: material_subcategory
columns.description: Source-specific subclass, e.g. a mineral group or plant functional type.

columns.name: material_formula
columns.description: Chemical formula where applicable.

columns.name: material_keywords
columns.description: Search terms.

columns.name: sample_id
columns.description: Physical sample identifier at the source.

columns.name: sample_description
columns.description: Free-text description of the sample.

columns.name: sample_particle_size
columns.description: Particle size or size range as reported.

columns.name: sample_origin
columns.description: Geographic or geological origin.

columns.name: sample_owner
columns.description: Institution or person holding the sample.

columns.name: sample_collection_date
columns.description: Date the sample was collected.

columns.name: sample_preparation
columns.description: Sample preparation procedure.

columns.name: measurement_instrument
columns.description: Instrument make and model.

columns.name: measurement_instrument_type
columns.description: Instrument class. Recommended values: 'laboratory_spectrometer', 'field_spectrometer', 'ftir', 'imaging_spectrometer', 'goniometer' (spec section 5).

columns.name: measurement_laboratory
columns.description: Laboratory or facility.

columns.name: measurement_date
columns.description: Date of measurement.

columns.name: measurement_processing
columns.description: Processing applied to the values, in order, e.g. 'averaged', 'interpolated', 'resampled', 'simulated', 'absorbance_from_reflectance'.

columns.name: measurement_light_source
columns.description: Illumination source, e.g. 'sun', 'lamp'.

columns.name: measurement_venue
columns.description: Where the measurement was made, e.g. 'laboratory', 'field', 'greenhouse'.

columns.name: measurement_acquisition_method
columns.description: e.g. 'contact', 'integrating_sphere', 'imaging_spectrometer'.

columns.name: measurement_foreoptic
columns.description: Fore-optic, e.g. 'leaf clip', 'contact probe', 'bare fibre'.

columns.name: measurement_reference
columns.description: Reference the values are relative to: 'spectralon', 'halon', 'gold', 'stainless_steel_mirror', 'blackbody', or 'absolute' for values corrected to absolute reflectance (spec section 5).

columns.name: bandpass_fwhm
columns.description: Full width at half maximum per band, in `wavelength_unit`. Same length as `wavelengths`.

columns.name: values_stddev
columns.description: Standard deviation of each value, same length as `values`, non-negative or NaN.

columns.name: quality_notes
columns.description: Free-text quality notes.

columns.name: extra
columns.description: Optional on any file without a declaration: a JSON object of producer-specific metadata.

columns.name: num_points
columns.description: Index files only: number of points in the spectrum.

columns.name: file
columns.description: Index files only: path (relative to the index file) or URL of the collection file holding the spectrum.
